meaning: to promote, sell (products, usually by pushing)

senses.en: to promote, sell (products, usually by pushing)

note: 推销员 = salesperson; 推销产品 / 推销自己.

examples.zh: 他的工作是向客人推销新产品。
examples.en: His job is to promote new products to customers.

examples.zh: 有人打电话来推销保险。
examples.en: Someone phoned to sell insurance.

examples.zh: 我不太会推销自己。
examples.en: I'm not very good at selling myself.

note: 按顺序 (in order), 顺序不对.

examples.zh: 请按顺序排队。
examples.en: Please line up in order.

examples.zh: 做菜的顺序不能换。
examples.en: The order of cooking steps can't be changed.

examples.zh: 你把顺序弄错了吧？
examples.en: You got the order wrong, didn't you?

note: Takes an object directly: 梦见你 / 梦见自己 + clause.

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上梦见奶奶了。
examples.en: I dreamed about Grandma last night.

examples.zh: 你有没有梦见过自己飞？
examples.en: Have you ever dreamed that you were flying?

examples.zh: 他梦见自己考了一百分。
examples.en: He dreamed that he scored a hundred.

meaning: meaning, implication (of a word, sign, remark)

senses.en: meaning, implication (of a word, sign, remark)

note: Deeper than 意思: 深刻的含义, 字面含义.

examples.zh: 这个词还有别的含义吗？
examples.en: Does this word have any other meaning?

examples.zh: 我不明白他这句话的含义。
examples.en: I don't understand the implication of what he said.

examples.zh: 这个图案有很深的含义。
examples.en: This pattern has a deep meaning.

meaning: to be defeated, lose; to fail; to spoil

senses.en: to be defeated, lose; to fail; to spoil

note: Mostly in compounds: 失败, 打败, 战败; 败给 = lose to.

examples.zh: 我们队败给了对手。
examples.en: Our team lost to the opponent.

examples.zh: 他败了，但是还想再来一次。
examples.en: He lost, but he wants to try again.

examples.zh: 你能败他吗？
examples.en: Can you beat him?

note: 中国大陆 = mainland China, as opposed to Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan.

examples.zh: 你去过中国大陆吗？
examples.en: Have you been to mainland China?

examples.zh: 地球上有七块大陆。
examples.en: There are seven continents on Earth.

examples.zh: 这个手机在大陆能用吗？
examples.en: Can this phone be used on the mainland?

note: 燃料电池 (fuel cell), 汽车燃料.

examples.zh: 汽车没有燃料就不能走。
examples.en: A car can't go without fuel.

examples.zh: 现在燃料的价格越来越高。
examples.en: Fuel prices are getting higher and higher.

examples.zh: 这种燃料对环境比较好。
examples.en: This kind of fuel is relatively good for the environment.

examples.zh: 奶奶给我讲了一个神话。
examples.en: Grandma told me a myth.

examples.zh: 这是一个古代的神话故事。
examples.en: This is an ancient myth.

examples.zh: 你知道这个神话的来源吗？
examples.en: Do you know the origin of this myth?

examples.zh: 暑假你有什么打算？
examples.en: What are your plans for the summer vacation?

examples.zh: 孩子们下个星期就放暑假了。
examples.en: The kids start their summer vacation next week.

examples.zh: 去年暑假，我们去了海边。
examples.en: Last summer vacation, we went to the seaside.

note: 供应商 = supplier; 供应不足 = short supply.

examples.zh: 这家饭店供应早餐。
examples.en: This hotel provides breakfast.

examples.zh: 现在水果的供应很少，价格很高。
examples.en: Fruit supply is low now, so prices are high.

examples.zh: 这个地区的水供应很稳定。
examples.en: The water supply in this area is very stable.

meaning: pay and benefits; treatment (in a job or status)

senses.en: pay and benefits; treatment (in a job or status)

note: 工资待遇, 待遇不错; 同等待遇 = equal treatment.

examples.zh: 这家公司的待遇怎么样？
examples.en: What are the pay and benefits like at this company?

examples.zh: 他因为待遇太低，所以换了工作。
examples.en: He changed jobs because the pay was too low.

examples.zh: 外国人和中国人应该有一样的待遇。
examples.en: Foreigners and Chinese should get the same treatment.

note: 代我问候你妈妈 = give my regards to your mom; 问候语.

examples.zh: 请代我问候你的家人。
examples.en: Please give my regards to your family.

examples.zh: 过年的时候，我们会打电话问候朋友。
examples.en: At New Year, we call to greet our friends.

examples.zh: 谢谢你的问候，我很好。
examples.en: Thanks for your greeting; I'm doing well.

note: 语音消息 (voice message), 语音输入; 语音 also = sound system.

examples.zh: 我在微信上给她发了一条语音。
examples.en: I sent her a voice message on WeChat.

examples.zh: 他的语音很标准。
examples.en: His pronunciation is very standard.

examples.zh: 开车的时候最好用语音输入。
examples.en: When driving, it's best to use voice input.

note: 电源线 (power cord), 打开/关闭电源.

examples.zh: 请先关电源，再修。
examples.en: Please turn off the power first, then repair it.

examples.zh: 手机的电源在哪儿？
examples.en: Where is the phone's power button?

examples.zh: 这台电脑没有电源，开不了。
examples.en: This computer has no power and won't turn on.

note: 维修电话, 维修费, 送去维修; more formal than 修.

examples.zh: 电梯正在维修，请走楼梯。
examples.en: The elevator is under maintenance; please use the stairs.

examples.zh: 这台空调需要维修。
examples.en: This air conditioner needs repair.

examples.zh: 请问，维修电话是多少？
examples.en: Excuse me, what is the repair hotline?

examples.zh: 新郎今天很帅，也很紧张。
examples.en: The groom looks handsome today, and he is nervous.

examples.zh: 你认识那位新郎吗？
examples.en: Do you know that groom?

examples.zh: 新郎和新娘都很高兴。
examples.en: The bride and groom are both very happy.

note: Formal: 获取信息, 获取帮助.

examples.zh: 你可以在网上获取更多信息。
examples.en: You can get more information online.

examples.zh: 这个手机需要获取你的位置。
examples.en: This phone needs to obtain your location.

examples.zh: 他想获取更多的帮助。
examples.en: He wants to get more help.

examples.zh: 他是中国很有名的诗人。
examples.en: He is a very famous Chinese poet.

examples.zh: 我的朋友想当诗人。
examples.en: My friend wants to become a poet.

examples.zh: 这位诗人写了很多好诗。
examples.en: This poet wrote many good poems.

note: Opposite 郊区; 去市区, 市区里.

examples.zh: 从机场到市区要多长时间？
examples.en: How long does it take from the airport to downtown?

examples.zh: 我家离市区很远。
examples.en: My home is far from the city center.

examples.zh: 市区里经常堵车。
examples.en: Traffic jams are frequent in the city center.

examples.zh: 睡觉前，妈妈给孩子讲童话。
examples.en: Before bed, Mom tells the child a fairy tale.

examples.zh: 这本书里有很多童话故事。
examples.en: This book has many fairy tales.

examples.zh: 你小时候喜欢看童话吗？
examples.en: Did you like reading fairy tales as a child?
